definition: [ חָשַׁל ] verb shatter (Biblical Aramaic חֲשַׁל shatter ; Late Hebrew Pi`el, || משׁבר ; Syriac forge a metal, Arabic drive cattle violently ; Assyrian —ašâlu , shatter , destroy Zim BP 12 Dl Pr 42 ) — Niph`al Participle figurative כָּלֿ הַנֶּחֱשָׁלִים Deut 25:18 all the shattered ones , i.e. those broken down, worn out, followed by וְאַתָּה עָיֵף וְיָגֵעַ ; others think = חלשׁ .
